proposition.claim:
The displayed N-scaled family with parameter range 0<=s<=2NK(m) is asserted to classify all nonstraight pinned critical points of E^lambda.

Smooth unit-speed immersed planar curve. Positive multiplier lambda=1. Endpoints (0,0), (ell,0) with ell>0. Curvature vanishes at both endpoints. Euler-Lagrange equation 2k''+k^3-lambda k=0. Pinned first-variation boundary term vanishes for all admissible endpoint-fixing variations.
